Variable dictionary

Source: vignettes/variable-dictionary.Rmd
variable-dictionary.Rmd

This vignette lists every field in the natality public-use file record layout – its description, byte width and type – together with the value labels for every coded field. Both tables come from [natality_layout()] and [natality_values()] and need no external resource (NCHS_NAT_PATH / NCHS_NAT_PARQUET) to build.

library(nchsNatality)
library(data.table)
#> 
#> Attaching package: 'data.table'
#> The following object is masked from 'package:base':
#> 
#>     %notin%

Fields

One row per field that is actually readable (the FILLER blocks that pad out unused bytes are omitted). kind is "numeric" for fields read as numbers and "code" for fields whose values are a fixed set of labelled codes – see the Value labels table below for those.

fields <- natality_layout()[kind != "filler",
                             .(name, description, kind, width)]

if (have_dt) {
  DT::datatable(fields, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
                 options = list(pageLength = 15))
} else {
  knitr::kable(fields)
}

Value labels

Every documented code and its label, for every coded field (block 1 is the coding used for US records; block 2, where present, is the separate coding for Puerto Rico and the other territories – see ?natality_values). Numeric fields have no entry here; their sentinel/“unknown” codes, where documented, are also listed in this table (e.g. DBWT 9999).

values <- natality_values()

if (have_dt) {
  DT::datatable(values, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
                 options = list(pageLength = 15))
} else {
  knitr::kable(values)
}
